Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Social Media & Community Marketeer position at prado. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in social media coordination, content creation, and community engagement, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your multi-brand, multi-market strategy.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO and content for client websites, which has honed my ability to adapt tone of voice across different brands and audiences. My own project, mirook.com, involved building a WordPress site and integrating social media channels, where I learned to schedule posts, engage with followers, and analyze performance data.

I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a B1 level in Dutch and actively improving. I am organized, proactive, and comfortable handling multiple tasks. I am eager to bring my creativity and analytical mindset to prado's marketing team, working closely with designers and content creators to grow reach and engagement.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills align with your needs. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Social Media & Community Marketeer position at prado. With a background in digital marketing, content creation, and community engagement, I am drawn to prado's innovative approach to home technology and its international growth. I am eager to contribute to your marketing team by supporting social media management across multiple brands and markets.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO and write keyword-targeted content for client websites. This experience has sharpened my writing and editing skills, and taught me to adapt tone of voice to different brand identities. I am comfortable using content management systems and social media platforms, including Meta, Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube. I have also leveraged AI tools to enhance content creation, ensuring efficiency and creativity.

My project mirook.com allowed me to design and build a WordPress site, integrate social media channels, and manage content. I scheduled posts, engaged with followers, and monitored engagement data to refine content strategies. This hands-on experience has given me a solid foundation in community management and social media optimization.

I am organized, proactive, and thrive in collaborative environments. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a B1 level in Dutch and actively improving. I am comfortable handling multiple tasks and am eager to learn from the experienced team at prado.

I am particularly excited about the opportunity to work with US content creators and the performance marketing team to align activity across channels. I am confident that my skills in content creation, social media management, and data analysis will allow me to contribute effectively to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can support prado's growth.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
